scripts.build:all: bun run build:tui:plugins && bun run build:plugin:all
scripts.build:core: cargo build -p agent-tool -p agent-core -p agent-session --release --target-dir target/core
scripts.build:tui: bun run build:tui:core && bun run build:tui:plugins
scripts.build:tui:core: bun run models:update && cargo build -p lucia --release --no-default-features --target-dir target/core-tui
scripts.build:tui:plugins: bun run models:update && cargo build -p lucia --release --features plugins --target-dir target/plugin-tui
scripts.install:all: bun run build:plugin:all && bun run install:plugin:official && bun run install:tui:plugins
scripts.package:plugin:official: bun run build:plugin:official && bun run scripts/package-official-plugins.ts
scripts.build:plugin:all: bun run build:plugin:official && bun run build:plugin:examples
scripts.test:plugin:agent-runtime: bun run build:plugin:agent-runtime && cargo test --offline -p agent-runtime-plugin-smoke-tests
scripts.test:plugin:mcp: cargo test --offline -p mcp-plugin && bun run build:plugin:mcp && cargo test --offline -p mcp-plugin-smoke-tests -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.test:plugin:teammate: cargo test --offline -p teammate-plugin && bun run build:plugin:teammate && cargo test --offline -p teammate-plugin-smoke-tests
scripts.test:plugin:plan: cargo test --offline -p plan-plugin && bun run build:plugin:plan && cargo test --offline -p plan-plugin-smoke-tests
scripts.test:plugin:memory: cargo test --offline -p memory-plugin && bun run build:plugin:memory
scripts.test:plugin:knowledge: cargo test --offline -p knowledge-plugin && bun run build:plugin:knowledge
scripts.test:plugin:eden: cargo test --offline -p eden-plugin && bun run build:plugin:eden && cargo test --offline -p eden-plugin-smoke-tests
scripts.test:plugin:permission: cargo test --offline -p permission-plugin && bun run build:plugin:permission && cargo test --offline -p permission-plugin-smoke-tests
scripts.test:plugin:official: bun run test:plugin:mcp && bun run test:plugin:teammate && bun run test:plugin:plan && bun run test:plugin:memory && bun run test:plugin:knowledge && bun run test:plugin:eden
scripts.docs:rust: cargo doc -p agent-core -p agent-tool -p agent-session -p agent-runtime -p agent-plugin-host -p agent-plugin -p agent-plugin-manager --lib --no-deps
scripts.docs:rust:private: cargo doc -p agent-core -p agent-tool -p agent-session -p agent-runtime -p agent-plugin-host -p agent-plugin -p agent-plugin-manager --lib --no-deps --document-private-items
